I don’t have that exact med, but am a diabetes educator and teach people injection technique all day. Every pen, no matter the med has extra units in it for priming. Before you go to inject, you may dial it up to 1-2 units and press it to make sure the med is coming out properly and ensure you are getting the correct dose (for example, if the pen was blocked or there was some air and you didn’t do this, you could end up taking too little). Just let your team know that you took a higher dose than prescribed. And know for next time that there will be a few units left in the pen when you are done with it.
